verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a deployment platform with a CLI and dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The only tracking-related item (netlify-docs-17) describes analytics on project and visitor behavior, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
